selected_evidence.requirement: Discover routed topology between node1/node2 and node3/node4
selected_evidence.summary: ARP-broadcast capture with tcpdump on node1/node2 eth1/eth2 while node3/node4 sent broadcasts proved node1+node2 eth1 both face node3, node1+node2 eth2 both face node4

selected_evidence.requirement: Implement single gateway with VRRP via Ansible, node1 preferred
selected_evidence.summary: ansible-playbook site.yml run from node5 configured VRRP groups on node1(pri150)/node2(pri100) and RHEL routes; show vrrp confirms node1 MASTER, node2 BACKUP on both groups

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 has single gateway address reaching node4
selected_evidence.summary: node3 route table shows 10.10.14.0/24 via 10.10.13.254 (VRRP VIP); ping from node3 to node4 succeeds

selected_evidence.requirement: Gateway stays available when node1 (preferred router) is down
selected_evidence.summary: Disabling node1 eth1/eth2 caused node2 to become MASTER within seconds; node3->node4 ping continued uninterrupted on same gateway IP
Re-enabling node1 interfaces caused it to reclaim MASTER (priority 150) automatically; node2 returned to BACKUP; continuous ping log showed only 2/34 losses during the whole failover+failback cycle

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 32669db3...; reboot acked; new boot_id ea4bdbd8... proves restart; post-restart interfaces/VIPs/VRRP MASTER role and node3->node4 ping confirm recovery

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9d3cb897...; reboot acked; new boot_id 94a4b677... proves restart; post-restart interfaces and VRRP BACKUP role confirm recovery, with node1 unaffected (quorum preserved)

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 73bafeef...; reboot acked (after sudo fix); new boot_id 57fbb60c... proves restart; post-restart ifcfg-eth1/route-eth1 and successful ping to node4 confirm recovery

selected_evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ef457a88...; reboot acked; new boot_id 8cd601a8... proves restart; post-restart interface/route and successful ping to node3 confirm recovery

selected_evidence.requirement: node5 (Ansible control node) restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id eefaca89...; reboot acked; new boot_id d7b5d099... proves restart; ansible-vrrp project files intact post-restart, SSH to node3/node4 still functional (VyOS SSH key added post-hoc to /home/vyos/.ssh did not persist since VyOS only persists /config, noted as a limitation for that specific access path, not the deployed configuration)

selected_evidence.requirement: Final overall cluster health after all restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Post-all-restarts check: node1 MASTER (pri150) on both VRRP groups, node2 BACKUP (pri100), node4->node3 ping succeeds through the persisted single gateway
